identity.note: Generic nanoparticle mentions in unrelated biotech descriptions are not identity matches. UZH and ETH parent records exist; the separate lab identity and official domain are expressly reviewed. Recheck production before apply.

scope.decision: Original medical materials and device research qualifies under the distinct research-lab rule
scope.evidence: Balgrist's named-lab announcement and scientific report attribute materials, sensors and tissue-repair research to this laboratory; the lab's own current site identifies its facilities and projects
